---
description: "Use when creating or editing Markdown documentation, README files, prompts, notes, or other .md content. Requires French prose for Markdown edits."
name: "French Markdown"
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# French Markdown Instructions

- When creating or editing Markdown files, write all generated or revised natural language prose in French.
- Preserve Markdown syntax, code fences, inline code, commands, file paths, API names, identifiers, and proper nouns unless the user explicitly asks to translate them.
- Keep quoted user-provided text in its original language unless translating it is part of the requested Markdown edit.
